owner: Director (docs/video/director-script.md). The Recorder films each recorded shot from this contract and reports any difference as a deviation, never a change.

needs.none: Rendered in Remotion from stored captures or slides; nothing to film.
needs.dev-pilot: Filmed on a developer's own Apps Script project and dev workbook (pilot/README.md, Set up your dev project). Google surfaces load with a saved, signed-in storage state; the Recorder never types a password.
needs.ge: Needs the Gemini Enterprise licence and the shared pilot (#7, #49). Never filmed on a stand-in; the cut shows a title card until then.

shots.on_camera: The 2 November 5-minute rain bars from the capture rise in time order from 14:00 to 16:00; the 15:30 exit wave is one 1px crimson line; 63.0 mm over the two hours prints at the end.

shots.surface: The window Form made by createWindowForm (#50), then the windows tab of the dev workbook.
shots.setup_off_camera: Form open in a fresh tab; the windows tab scrolled to its last row.
shots.on_camera: Type a club window (title, kind event, a real upcoming date, start and end in MYT), tick consent, submit; cut to the new windows row.
shots.privacy: Use the team's own test address, masked in the edit; no subscriber's name or email on screen.

shots.surface: The readings tab of the dev workbook while the dev JPS, MET and APIMS pollers run by hand.
shots.setup_off_camera: Run each poller once so the newest rows are minutes old.
shots.on_camera: The newest readings rows: source, station, value, observed time and age; a slow pan across the age column.

The window strip for the 15:30 release wave from the capture: 5-minute bars, the rolling 60-minute total against the Lebat band, the window as a 1px crimson line. Hold at 14:55 (29.5 mm, Normal); the 15:00 bar lands and the total crosses at 39.0 mm, slowed; at the 15:05 poll the mode word flips to Commute disruption with 'Storm confirmed · gauge 39.0 mm in 60 min to 15:00 (Lebat) · 5 min old' under it.
shots.label: replay.label

shots.surface: The Gemini Enterprise replay workflow (pilot/workflows/sky-crossing-replay.md) on the shared pilot.
shots.on_camera: The bundle: the agent's call per window with reasons and input ages, the clause engine's shadow verdict beside it, Needs Review, then the approver's approval.

shots.surface: The ledger tab of the dev workbook and the Apps Script execution log.
shots.setup_off_camera: Seal a dev ledger row with the #62 sweep; keep a second tab on the editor with verifyLedger selected.
shots.on_camera: The sealed row and its hash; edit one cell of an earlier row; run verifyLedger; the log names the broken row; undo the edit.

shots.surface: Gmail of a teammate's account and the team inbox after the dev evidence poll (#58).
shots.setup_off_camera: Activate the dev inbox per #58; send 'evidence for 2 Nov 14:00–16:30' from a teammate's account; run the poll.
shots.on_camera: The request in the sent folder, then the pack reply opened: readings, sources and times.
shots.privacy: Mask both addresses in the edit.

shots.on_camera: The haze replay tally builds one weekday at a time: 9 Hybrid recommended, 5 Outdoor-limited, 7 Normal, 1 no data (22 weekdays, 5 Oct to 3 Nov 2026, Cheras CA16W at 06:00); then 'Live grades: n=0'.
